checks.name: Privacy Policy Availability
checks.evidence: Privacy policy page found (4,000 characters of text read).
checks.explanation: A privacy policy page was found on the scanned pages and its text was read.

checks.name: Personal Data Collection Disclosure
checks.explanation: The policy states the personal data it collects; the quoted passage was verified word for word against the policy text.

checks.name: Purpose of Data Processing
checks.explanation: The analysis marked this as verified but gave no quoted passage, so it is not counted.
checks.limitation: No privacy policy text was available to read; the text of other pages is not kept.

checks.name: Data Sharing and Third Parties
checks.evidence: We share personal data with analytics providers, payment processors and hosting providers.
checks.explanation: The policy states sharing of personal data with processors and other third parties; the quoted passage was verified word for word against the policy text.

checks.name: Data Retention Disclosure
checks.explanation: The analysis marked this as verified but gave no quoted passage, so it is not counted.
checks.limitation: No privacy policy text was available to read; the text of other pages is not kept.

checks.name: User Rights Disclosure
checks.explanation: The policy names 3 of 3 user rights and the means of making a request.

checks.name: Contact and Grievance Mechanism
checks.explanation: A grievance contact was found together with a business contact and a response period.

checks.name: Cookie and Tracker Detection
checks.evidence: 3 cookies and 4 third-party requests observed (Google Ads, Google Analytics, Static CDN, _ga).
checks.explanation: Detection ran on the pages that loaded, but 1 page did not load, so tracking there could not be observed.
checks.legal: Relates to DPDP Act s.6(1); Rules r.3
checks.limitation: Absence of a tracker is not proof that none exists under all conditions. Detection covers 3 of 40 pages. 2 observed items could not be classified as necessary, analytics or advertising.

checks.name: Consent Behaviour
checks.evidence: Analytics/marketing requests: before consent 0, after Accept 2, after Reject 0. Analytics/marketing cookies and requests seen before consent: 1.
checks.explanation: Analytics or marketing requests were observed before any consent action.
checks.legal: Relates to DPDP Act s.6(1), 6(4); Rules r.3(c)(i)

checks.name: Privacy Evidence and Transparency
checks.evidence: 7 of 7 findings (checks 1 to 9; this check is not counted in its own evidence) trace to an evidence excerpt and a page the scan read.
checks.explanation: Each finding can be traced to its excerpt and to a page that was read. Checks 3, 5 could not be assessed and are listed under the limitations.

formula: Score = marks awarded ÷ applicable marks × 100 = 7 ÷ 8 × 100 = 87.5 (2 checks could not be assessed, left out of the maximum)
summary: 7 / 8 marks across 8 assessed checks, from 3 of the 40 pages found on the entered domain. 2 could not be assessed and are left out. Consent was tested once, on the homepage. An indicative readiness reading, not a legal determination or certification.

recommendations.text: Review the cookies and trackers observed and classify each as necessary, analytics or advertising.
Confirm that analytics and advertising stay off before consent and after Reject, on every page with a banner.
Run the scan again when the pages it could not read are reachable, so the checks left out can be assessed.

limitations: 3 pages of the entered domain were scanned of 40 found; the text of pages other than the privacy policy is not kept.
1 page did not load (see the page list).
Checks 3, 5 could not be assessed (left out of the score): No privacy policy text was available to read; the text of other pages is not kept.
